$comment: The last Claude Code version whose changelog was reviewed against this platform's home-grown machinery.
Read by .claude/hooks/harness-drift-check.mjs on SessionStart; when the installed version differs, the hook
asks for the T1 review and points here. Committed on purpose: 'last reviewed' is a platform fact, not a
machine fact, so whichever machine upgrades first does the review once for all of them.
Why this exists: between 2026-06-14 and 06-20 roughly six sessions went into 'auto-pilot' — an external
orchestrator, a scheduled wrapper and a signed Discord approval control plane. Claude Code then shipped
scheduled cloud agents and remote execution natively, and on 2026-07-28 the whole thing was deleted. Nothing
in the process was wrong; the premise had silently expired and no step ever re-checked it. This file is that

replaced: auto-pilot orchestrator + scheduled wrapper -> native scheduled cloud agents (/schedule) and remote agent execution
hand-rolled shared-memory loading via @import -> native auto memory (autoMemoryDirectory), which additionally ENFORCES the 200-line/25KB index cap and stamps `modified`
kept: autonomy-gate.mjs — the safety tier is not superseded by native remote execution; a remote run is more autonomous, not less
